title: Project Manager - Operations
text:
About the Role
Own operations projects across our Bay Area distribution network: process changes, site launches and vendor transitions.
Qualifications
2+ years required, 3+ preferred, of project management experience in operations or logistics.
Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering or a related field required.
